summary: A Yes vote raises the city's transient occupancy (hotel lodging) tax from 10% to 12%, projected to generate about $700,000 per year.

tax.text: Measure I's supporters advocate raising Eureka's hotel tax from 10% to 12% to fund essential city services.
tax.quote: A YES vote on Measure I is a vote to support the quality of life in Eureka while ensuring that visitors help pay for the services they use.

tax.text: A No vote would reject Measure I’s proposed two-percentage-point increase in Eureka’s transient occupancy tax.
tax.quote: A “no” vote is a vote against the enactment of a 2% increase in the City’s Transient Occupancy Tax.
